Content: `text(Ten years)` ago, scientists discovered a well-preserved set of dinosaur remains in China. This dinosaur, which walked on `text(Earth)` about `text(125 million years)` ago, had feathers and was about the same size as a turkey — but don’t be fooled. This dino’s bite was a lot worse than a turkey’s gobble. After a close (and careful!) examination of the dino’s teeth, scientists recently concluded that this dinosaur was probably poisonous. The study was led by David Burnham, who works and teaches at the University of Kansas in Lawrence.
